description: Read a wiki page's hand-written «Literature» list (the section headed Литература, Literature, References or Bibliography) against its project's register of sources. Without 'take' nothing is written: each line comes back with what was read of it — its key in front ('[IMP26] …'), arXiv id, DOI, MR, zbMATH number, authors, title, venue, year, the † — and an offer: 'new' (a source to add; 'suggestedKey' where the line has no key), 'known' (the register has it as 'source': cite it as [@source] instead of the line), 'conflict' (its key is another work's: take it with 'as', a new key) or 'unread' (nothing to make a source of). The reading of the words is a guess — show the person the lines and what was read before taking. Call again with 'take' — the lines chosen — to add them, unchecked; each says 'created', 'skipped' or 'refused' with the reason. Anybody who may read the page reads; members who may write take.

take.description: The lines to add, as a JSON array: [{"index":0},{"index":3,"as":"Tah81b"}] — 'index' as the offers numbered them, 'as' a key of your own. Leave out to only read.
